name: locationMap
caption: Location maps of the site. The map on the left shows the region. The map on the right shows the island and its surroundings. The red point shows the actual site and green points (if present) indicate other available wave climate reports in the region.

name: annualWaveRose
caption: Annual wave rose for {locName}. Note that directions are where the waves are coming from.

name: monthlyWaveVariation
caption: Monthly wave height (black line), wave period (red  line), and wave direction (arrows). The gray area represents the range of wave height between calm periods 10% of lowest wave height and large wave event (10%  of highest wave height).

name: annualWaveVariation
caption: Annual wave height (black line), wave period (red  line), and wave direction (arrows). The gray area represents the range of wave height between calm periods 10% of lowest wave height and large wave event (10%  of highest wave height).

name: largeWaveRose
caption: Large, severe and extreme wave rose for {locName}.

name: monthlyWaveVariation_large
caption: Monthly variation in large waves (90th percentile, dark blue line), severe waves (99th percentile, light blue line) and the largest wave (green line) in {locName}.

name: annualWaveVariation_large
caption: Annual variation in large waves (90th percentile, dark blue line), severe waves (99th percentile, light blue line) and the largest wave (green line) in {locName}.

name: extremeValuesAnalysis
caption: Extreme wave distribution for {locName}. The red circles represent the wave events that occured since {yearStart}. The plain line is the statistical distribution that best fits the past wave events. The dashed lines show the upper and lower high confidence of the fit, there is a 95% chance that the fitted distribution lies between the two dashed lines.

name: annualWindRose
caption: Annual wind rose for {locName}. Note that directions are where the waves are coming from.

name: monthlyWindVariation
caption: Monthly wind speed (black line) and direction (arrows).
